blogs.title: Why Your AI Model Collapses: The Hidden Flaw in Current Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
blogs.description: An accessible deep dive into why popular algorithms like GRPO fail when training massive LLMs. This post breaks down the concept of 'high-variance noise' caused by token-level importance sampling, explaining how small errors accumulate over long generations to cause catastrophic model collapse—and why fixing this requires changing the fundamental unit of optimization.

blogs.title: From Tokens to Sequences: How GSPO Stabilizes Large Language Model Training
blogs.description: Explore the core innovation behind Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO). We'll demystify the shift from calculating probabilities word-by-word to evaluating entire responses at once. Learn how matching the 'unit of reward' with the 'unit of optimization' creates a theoretically sounder framework that prevents the instability plaguing today's largest models.

blogs.title: Unlocking Mixture-of-Experts: Why GSPO Makes Sparse Models Trainable Without Hacks
blogs.description: Focusing on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, this article explains the unique challenge of 'expert-activation volatility.' Discover how GSPO naturally solves this problem, eliminating the need for complex workarounds like 'Routing Replay,' saving memory, and allowing models to utilize their full capacity without artificial constraints.

blogs.title: Simplifying AI Infrastructure: How GSPO Bridges the Gap Between Training and Inference Engines
blogs.description: A practical look at how GSPO simplifies the engineering stack for RL training. Because it relies on sequence-level likelihoods rather than precise token-level math, GSPO is more forgiving of precision differences between training and inference software. Find out how this opens doors for faster deployment, reduced costs, and easier implementation in modern AI pipelines.
